tools.name: search_events_by_keyword
tools.description: Search public EventMatey events by keyword, optional UK location text, date range, categories, and price range. Returns only published and bookable events that the organiser has enabled for AI discovery.

keyword.description: Keyword or phrase to search for, such as baking class or live music

location_text.description: Optional UK location hint such as Bristol, Manchester, or London

start_date.description: Optional inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD format

end_date.description: Optional inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD format

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return

tools.name: search_events_nearby
tools.description: Search EventMatey events by location. The current v1 implementation uses location_text plus date/category/price filters. Latitude/longitude and radius are accepted for forward compatibility but are not yet used for true distance search.

latitude.description: Optional latitude for future geo-capable search

longitude.description: Optional longitude for future geo-capable search

radius_km.description: Optional search radius in kilometres for future geo-capable search

location_text.description: Use this for the current v1 location search, such as Bristol or Leeds

start_date.description: Optional inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD format

end_date.description: Optional inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD format

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return

tools.name: get_event_details
tools.description: Get fuller public details for one discoverable EventMatey event, including the canonical hosted booking URL.
